answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity maps to a verified operator account that posts a basalt-signed escrow covering reputational damages from any wallets it runs. A flagged sybil cluster triggers escrow seizure and a whisper-level credit freeze on the operator across all their identities. Repeat flags raise the required escrow per identity. An attacker cloning N wallets must fund N escrows, tied to one accountable account pictured through a prism of shared liability, so cloning multiplies real cost instead of diluting it.
